problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate budget across 20 neighborhood development projects to maximize the total community benefit score.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.163, impact factor 0.015, allocation limits [0.025, 0.488]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.055, impact factor 0.154, allocation limits [0.014, 0.691]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.129, impact factor 0.124, allocation limits [0.062, 0.493]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.076, impact factor 0.118, allocation limits [0.047, 0.725]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.078, impact factor 0.169, allocation limits [0.072, 0.609]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.112, impact factor 0.041, allocation limits [0.057, 0.815]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.024, impact factor 0.075, allocation limits [0.023, 0.896]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.069, impact factor 0.293, allocation limits [0.077, 0.349]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.056, impact factor 0.125, allocation limits [0.025, 0.363]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.068, impact factor 0.077, allocation limits [0.031, 0.720]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.138, impact factor 0.117, allocation limits [0.034, 0.525]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.105, impact factor 0.173, allocation limits [0.015, 0.754]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.072, impact factor 0.196, allocation limits [0.032, 0.397]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.037, impact factor 0.106, allocation limits [0.057, 0.749]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.194, impact factor 0.245, allocation limits [0.041, 0.400]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.121, impact factor 0.293, allocation limits [0.001, 0.563]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.107, impact factor 0.038, allocation limits [0.069, 0.883]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.183, impact factor 0.059, allocation limits [0.076, 0.323]  
* Project S: benefit score 0.116, impact factor 0.261, allocation limits [0.079, 0.555]  
* Project T: benefit score 0.064, impact factor 0.152, allocation limits [0.055, 0.402]  

Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified limits, and all fractions must sum to one. To meet urgent community needs, the set of priority projects L = {C, E, G, H, I, K, L, O, P} must collectively receive at least 0.349 of the total budget. Additionally, the overall community impact index must not exceed 0.151, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.075. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
